_readme: Upcoming brand briefs the scheduler pre-builds soft rosters against.
Operator-maintained: add a block when a brief lands, remove it when the campaign closes.
Required per campaign: id, brand_name, category.
Optional, and inherited from config.DEFAULT_BRIEF when omitted: product_description,
campaign_goal, target_audience, platforms, cpm, follower_band, shortlist_size,
exclusions. 'status', 'brief_received' and 'notes' are for humans and do not affect
'category' is the field that does the most work. Campaign role comes from Category
Readiness, and a readiness judgement is evidence about ONE named category. Creators in
data/creators.json were judged against 'AI app-building tools', so a brief in any other
category returns those rows as NEEDS_REVIEW rather than assigning a role from evidence
about something else. That is the guard working, not an empty result — judge the pool
against the new category (set readiness + readiness_category on each row) to score it.

campaigns.product_description: An AI tool that builds a working app from a plain-English description. Craftly for Students positions it as the tool for university students who want to build without knowing how to code.
campaigns.target_audience: US university students aged 18-24, or creators whose audience skews 18-24 and US-dominant.
campaigns.notes: The campaign this repo was built for. Sourced set lives in data/creators.json.
